narrative_synthesis: Seedance 2.5 continuous-shot / no-cut transitions and 'prompt share' CTAs keep winning in AI VFX; techhalla's retro short 'Toxicity (1974)' is the day's monster (148K). Genie 4 (real-time AI worlds) is the news wave of the day.

drafts.draft_en: One shot. No cuts. The camera never moves, the world does. Built it with Seedance 2.5, locked first frame, 4 eras in 12 seconds. Full prompt below 👇
drafts.video_tip: 12s locked-off shot: a character stays perfectly still while the background cycles through 4 eras (1920s, 1974, today, 2080). Match light direction across eras so it reads as one continuous take.

drafts.draft_en: What if this trailer was shot in 1974? Same scene, real film grain, practical-looking VFX, zero modern gloss. Made with AI. Prompts below 👇
drafts.video_tip: 10-15s faux 70s trailer: 4:3 crop, heavy grain, warm halation, one big practical-style VFX moment (explosion or creature) at second 6. End on a period title card.

drafts.draft_en: Google's Genie 4 lets you walk inside AI worlds in real time. As a VFX artist, here's what that changes for previs, and what it doesn't. 🧵
drafts.video_tip: Split screen: left a classic previs blockout, right your AI-generated environment fly-through of the same shot. 8-10s, then a text card with your take.

drafts.draft_en: Did this feel real to you? Every frame is AI. The trick is not the model, it's the physics: smoke, water and cloth reacting on time. Prompt share below 👇
drafts.video_tip: 6-8s close-up with heavy practical-style physics (water splash or smoke through light rays), shot like a real camera with slight handheld; reveal the prompt in the first reply.

drafts.draft_en: Saturday Challenge preview: one image, six worlds. I'll give you a single first frame, you give me the wildest no-cut transition. Kling 4.0, Seedance, Grok Imagine, all welcome.
drafts.video_tip: Show the shared first frame, then a fast 3-clip montage of different transitions from it (2-3s each). End with the challenge rules on screen.
